title: PRD phase result (dev team, prd.md)
description: Validates the structured result object the prd phase returns alongside its prd.md artifact. artifactPath must equal the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml (the core's runtime enforces the same exact match); openQuestions are required with at least one entry because the human review gate after the PRD must see the unresolved scope decisions before approving it.

artifactPath.description: Exactly the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml; the runtime writes the reply body there and rejects any other value.

summary.description: Structured Chinese summary of prd.md: the user stories, the scope boundary with its non-goals, and the shape of the acceptance criteria (each independently decidable with an observable outcome).

openQuestions.description: Requirements the source material could not settle and decisions the human review gate must make; mirrors the PRD's open questions section, and no material gap is silently dropped.
